channel.title: The Lawrence Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Lawrence Times (lawrencekstimes.com)

item.title: Kansas disregards CDC vaccine changes, will trust scientific evidence instead
item.description: Kansas’ top health agency is sticking with the longstanding childhood immunization schedule instead of implementing new guidelines released Jan. 5 by the CDC, a state spokesperson said.

item.title: Kansas legislators hear divided testimony on proposed school cellphone ban
item.description: A bipartisan Kansas bill that aims to implement a bell-to-bell cellphone ban beginning next school year would override local rules and establish one of the nation’s most restrictive policies.

item.title: New lawsuit challenges City of Lawrence’s housing discrimination ordinance
item.description: A real estate company has filed a federal lawsuit against the City of Lawrence challenging an ordinance that bans discrimination based on where a potential tenant's rent payments would come from, such as housing vouchers.

item.title: Who can represent Kansas in court? Governor and attorney general clash at Supreme Court
item.description: The Kansas Supreme Court is considering who can represent the state in court, after Democratic Gov. Laura Kelly and Republican Attorney General Kris Kobach have clashed over taking legal action on behalf of the state.

item.title: Girl Bar hopes to sate the sapphic yearning for a community haven in Lawrence
item.description: Liberty Hall is looking to build a sapphic Eden with Girl Bar — a monthly night “for gurls and gals and nonbinary pals” — and this month, folks can catch the 1994 lesbian romcom that inspired it all.

item.title: Free State High School recognized as Special Olympics Unified Champion banner school
item.description: Free State High School was honored Friday with a banner from the Special Olympics, recognizing the school for cultivating an inclusive space for students with and without intellectual disabilities.

item.title: One teen killed, another injured in shooting at popular bar near KU in Lawrence
item.description: Update: An 18-year-old man was killed and a 16-year-old boy is in critical condition after a shooting around 2 a.m. Saturday at the Hawk in Lawrence. Two 18-year-olds have been arrested in connection.

item.title: Lawrence Public Library announces citywide book club selection, month of programming
item.description: The Lawrence Public Library selected "The Anthropocene Reviewed" by John Green for its Read Across Lawrence program, which will include a month of themed programming and book discussions.

item.title: Downtown Lawrence to welcome a baby boutique, bid farewell to a pizza joint and more updates
item.description: Downtown Lawrence is welcoming a new baby boutique and recently lost a pizza place, and a coffee shop is doubling down on its brick and mortar location after closing its mobile trailer.
